note: Vocabulary contract. Enums and status words are NOT hand-copied between Python, TypeScript and host JS (LANGUAGE-POLICY §5): this file records the one truth and design-lab/scripts/verify_state_vocabularies.py checks BOTH the Python services and the Workbench UI against it. It exists because a hand copy drifted -- the UI advertised the preflight verdict as 'PASS / BLOCKED' while runtime/task_resources.py only ever emits READY or BLOCKED.

taskResourcePreflight.semantics: blocked = any resource whose state is in blockingResourceStates. METADATA_ONLY (model recorded, never loaded) and DECLARED_NOT_PROBED (external/host/licence root declared, never traversed) are honest non-findings and do NOT block; a UI that renders them as failures would overstate a rejection the service never made.
